      "name": "What is Safe4?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Safe4 is a Nordic technology group delivering certified IoT infrastructure, alarm monitoring and white-label security solutions across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and the UK — and to partners across Europe."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is a white-label alarm solution?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "A white-label solution lets your company offer a fully branded alarm and IoT service to your customers — powered by Safe4's platform, hardware and certified monitoring centre — without building the infrastructure yourself."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Is Safe4's Alarm Receiving Centre certified?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes. Safe4 Certified Monitoring Services AS operates a 24/7 Alarm Receiving Centre certified to EN 50518 — the European standard for alarm monitoring centres — verified by Kiwa."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Which countries does Safe4 operate in?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Safe4 delivers services across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and the UK, with solutions available to partners across the EU."
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "Can Safe4 integrate with our existing platform?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",
        "text": "Yes. Safe4's IoT platform offers open APIs and supports integration with existing apps, ecosystems and partner platforms."
      }
    },

      "@type": "Question",
      "name": "What is Confi.care?",
      "acceptedAnswer": {
        "@type": "Answer",

It's built to support real services, in real environments – reliably and at scale. 30 k Installations by the end of 2025 300 k connected IoT devices by the end of 2025 30 k data points per gateway processed daily Latest news 13 . 8 . 2025 Norlandia and Safe4 Care enters strategic partnership: Making It safer to live at home – for more people Frequently asked questions What is Safe4? Safe4 is a Nordic technology group delivering certified IoT infrastructure, alarm monitoring and white-label security solutions across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and the UK — and to partners across Europe. What is a white-label alarm solution? A white-label solution lets your company offer a fully branded alarm and IoT service to your customers — powered by Safe4's platform, hardware and certified monitoring centre — without building the infrastructure yourself. Is Safe4's Alarm Receiving Centre certified? Yes. Safe4 Certified Monitoring Services AS operates a 24/7 Alarm Receiving Centre certified to EN 50518 — the European standard for alarm monitoring centres — verified by Kiwa. Which countries does Safe4 operate in? Safe4 delivers services across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and the UK, with solutions available to partners across the EU. Can Safe4 integrate with our existing platform? Yes. Safe4's IoT platform offers open APIs and supports integration with existing apps, ecosystems and partner platforms. What is Confi.care? Confi.care is Safe4's digital home care solution — delivering passive, sensor-based monitoring for elderly and vulnerable people without cameras, using 4G connectivity and deviation-based alerts to caregivers.
